title: Find Servers That Handled Most Number Of Requests
description: Find the servers that handled the maximum number of requests given arrival times and load durations.
pseudocode:
1. availableServers = MinHeap(0..k-1)
2. busyServers = MinHeap()
3. counts = Array(k, 0)
4. for i, (arrival, load) in requests:
5.   while busyServers.peek().time <= arrival:
6.     availableServers.push(busyServers.pop().id)
7.   if availableServers is empty: continue
8.   serverID = availableServers.findBest(i % k)
9.   counts[serverID]++
10.  busyServers.push(serverID, arrival + load)

steps.note: Server 1 is assigned as (0 % 3) is 0, but 0 is available, so 1 is picked
Server 1 is now busy until time 3
Check busy servers: server 1 ends at 3, not free yet
Server 2 is assigned (next available after index 1)
